description: Tell the person which problems you start on: call it before each group of fixes with the problem ids or codes (a code stands for every open problem of it) and a short plain note. Clears itself when those problems leave a newer check or the hand-off ends.

request_schema.description: `iii-cloud::handoff::progress` input: the agent says what it starts on.

handoff_id.description: The hand-off this progress is for (default: the selected environment's open one).

working_on.description: Problem ids, or codes (a code stands for every open problem of that code).

request_schema.title: HandoffProgressRequest

working_on.description: The problem ids the names resolved to in the newest check.
